thread:
maria: quick postmortem follow-up from the 03:12am CPU storm — putting action items here so they don't vanish. main goals: reduce noise, clarify owners, and set a timeline for changes.

maria: problems we saw: noisy CPU alerts for short bursts, duplicate pages from metric and anomaly alerts, and on-call fatigue during the 2–4am window. saw the same pattern 3x this quarter.

devon: +1. I can own remediation tracking. I'll add the three items to the incident board and put owners.

maria: thanks devon. assign owners but keep them light — two-week sprint for quick fixes, longer plan for infra-level work.

ashley: can we change the dedupe window first? current 5m means multiple pages for the same host when it spikes. propose 15m dedupe and bump severity threshold for bursty metrics. :thinking_face:

ashley: example alert rule we could tweak: ```alert: HighCPU
expr: avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[1m]) > 0.85
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: High CPU on {{ $labels.instance }}```

ashley: change `for` to `5m` and dedupe to 15m in paging policy, then watch.

tj: We should also add an anomaly filter for short-lived spikes. I've got a quick script to compute spike durations; can run across the last 90 days to see false positive rate.

tj: quick command I used: `promql_query --range=90d 'increase(node_cpu_seconds_total[5m]) / increase(node_cpu_seconds_total[1h])'` — gives a feel for transient bursts.

devon: plan from me: 1) update paging dedupe to 15m (owner: devon, target: 2 days), 2) adjust `for` for CPU alert to 5m (owner: ashley, target: 3 days), 3) run tj's spike analysis and propose anomaly rule (owner: tj, target: 2 weeks), 4) retro notes + ops doc update (owner: maria, target: 1 week).

maria: love it. please add the individual PR links in the board when you have them. also flag any changes that need an eng-sre review before rollout.

oncall-bot: reminder: paging-policy change requires a firebreak test. schedule 1-hour window with oncall during change.

devon: noted — scheduling firebreak tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will include runbook and rollback steps.

ashley: also adding a small cache for exporters that burst metrics during scrape errors — long term but might help. owner: ashley-infra, target: 6 weeks.

tj: I'll produce the spike false-positive numbers by EOD Friday and post graphs.

sre-lead: agree with 15m dedupe as a conservative start. if noise drops by >60% and latency of true alerts stays acceptable we can keep it. mark the metric on console for a week.

maria: final ask — everyone add a single acceptance test or a validation step to the PR (how we'll confirm noise reduction). short description in the ticket.

devon: done — will create the board items now and ping owners. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. we'll reconvene in 2 weeks to close any remaining todos.
